The positive case is mostly policy design and coordination; outcome evidence is thinner.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Executive Board Concludes the 2024 Article IV Consultation and Completes the Sixth Review under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for the Democratic Republic of the Congo","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/03/pr24253-drc-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-art-iv-consult-completes-6th-rev-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the authorities kept prudent macro policies, continued to avoid monetary financing, and made progress on revenue mobilization and reserve build-up.
